lines.text: The Daughter of Zion will leave the city, camp in the open fields, and go to Babylon, where the LORD will redeem her.
Many nations assemble against Zion, but they do not understand the LORD's plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
The LORD gives Zion horns of iron and hooves of silver to break many peoples to pieces.
A ruler over Israel will come from Bethlehem Ephrathah, and He will shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD.
When Assyria invades, seven shepherds and eight leaders will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Midian with the blade drawn.
